data.title: Biden admin. predicted how Israel would use Gaza war to escalate to Iran strikes | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: In an all-encompassing New Yorker report, several Biden administration officials alleged that they blame US President Trump and Prime Minister Netanyahu for allowing the Gaza war to spread to Iran.
